issues.failure_explanation: Statement (iii) claims the consistency bound for all m >= underline m := 1, but for m = 1 the term log(m)m^{-1/2} vanishes from the right-hand side while the estimator is inconsistent. With one sample X_1 from mu, the first-order optimality condition (eqn: OTmap-estimator-entropic-proof-shape-firstorderopt) forces g^theta_j = (1/2)||X_1 - Y_j||^2 - f^theta_1, so on support(mu) (where the gamma-modification vanishes) the estimator reduces to a softmax average sum_j exp(<Y_j, x - X_1>/theta) Y_j / sum_j exp(<Y_j, x - X_1>/theta) that depends on the single sample X_1 and does not converge to T^mu_nu as theta -> 0, n -> infinity. Concretely, for mu = nu = Uniform[0,1] (which belongs to CM^q(R), with T^mu_nu(x) = x), along theta_n = n^{-1/2} the estimator converges in probability to the threshold map x -> 1{x > X_1}, so E||T_hat - T^mu_nu||^2_{L^2(mu)} -> E[(X_1^3 + (1-X_1)^3)/3] = 1/6 > 0, whereas the stated right-hand side C_entr[theta^{-1/2} log(n) n^{-1/2} + theta^{bar alpha/2}] -> 0, contradicting the bound. The proof itself only derives the bound for m, n >= 2 via the cited Theorems 4 and 5 of Pooladian--Niles-Weed. Thus the statement as written (m >= 1) is false; the supported conclusion requires m >= 2.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Set underline m := 2 (equivalently, quantify the consistency bound over m >= 2). The shape and growth statements remain valid since their proofs hold for all m >= 1, and no downstream result changes.
issues.overall_effect: Part (iii) of Proposition prop: OTmap-estimator-entropic is false as stated for m = 1. Nothing downstream is affected: the 'In particular' admissibility conclusion (Assumption asp: OTmap-estimator(iii)) only invokes the bound for m, n >= bar n(mu,nu,epsilon) >= 7, and the algorithm's sample sizes in Setting sett: convergence satisfy N_hat >= 7, so Corollary cor: fixedpoint-convergence-entropic and the main convergence theorem are unaffected.
issues.title: Consistency bound of the modified entropic OT map estimator is false for m = 1 (quantifier m >= underline m = 1)
issues.why_classification: The repair is a one-token change of the constant underline m from 1 to 2 (a degenerate-case exclusion); every substantive claim, guarantee, rate, and the advertised scope survive with no new argument.

issues.failure_explanation: Through Setting sett: algo-iteration the corollary ranges over all q in N_0, including q = 0, and asserts almost-sure convergence of Algorithm algo: iteration driven by the modified entropic estimator. But Proposition prop: OTmap-estimator-entropic establishes that this estimator satisfies Assumption asp: OTmap-estimator (in particular the consistency condition) only for q >= 1: the consistency proof uses Caffarelli regularity with bar alpha(mu,nu) = min{q+2+alpha,4} in [3,4] and finiteness of the integrated Fisher information I_0(mu,nu), which requires nabla^2 phi^mu_nu Lipschitz, i.e., q+2 >= 3, hence q >= 1. For q = 0 the corollary therefore invokes the proposition outside its hypotheses, and convergence of the concrete entropic-estimator algorithm is unestablished for nu_1,...,nu_K in CM^0(R^d).
